Messages.Author: Thomas Bucy
Messages.Body:
Hi Shawn, you probably haven't seen a post
by me before, but you are sure to see many
in the future.

I have a couple of questions I would like
a ruling on.

1.) Concerning Brainwash: Brainwash says
it may be placed on a uncontolled vampire
of your prey and no transfers may be done
to that vampire. What I need to know is if
you can place more than one brianwash on
any given vampire. If so does a action
have to be taken to remove each brainwash,
or does one action remove all the
brainwashes on a given vampire.

2.) Concerning Victoria: Victoria is a
Malk vamp with a 5 cap and a special
ablility that says "If Victoria is ready
during your master faise you turn in the
edge to gain two blood". Somebody in my
play group thinks that if Victoria was
ready during his master faise this means
you can turn in the edge at any time
during your turn to gain two blood. He
turns in the edge for two blood, bleeds
takes the edge and turns it in again for
two blood, etc. We protested and didn't
allow him to do this. I think the spirit
of the card is that you turn in the edge
during your master phase once to gain two
blood.

Thanks for supporting perhaps the best
game I have ever played.

Steve -don't call me Tom- Bucy

Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
Thomas Bucy wrote:

> 1.) Concerning Brainwash: Brainwash says
> it may be placed on a uncontolled vampire
> of your prey and no transfers may be done
> to that vampire. What I need to know is if
> you can place more than one brianwash on
> any given vampire. If so does a action
> have to be taken to remove each brainwash,
> or does one action remove all the
> brainwashes on a given vampire.

Each Brainwash must be dealt with individually, so yes, you can
stack Brainwashes on a vampire you have no desire to ever be seen
in play. :)

> 2.) Concerning Victoria: Victoria is a
> Malk vamp with a 5 cap and a special
> ablility that says "If Victoria is ready
> during your master faise you turn in the
> edge to gain two blood". Somebody in my
> play group thinks that if Victoria was
> ready during his master faise this means
> you can turn in the edge at any time
> during your turn to gain two blood.

Nope--Victoria checks for her special ability during the master
phase only. The repeat "cash and carry" strategy doesn't work.

Take care...
